messages:
matthew: FYI sampleapp onboarding is failing in CI after the latest typegen semver bump (0.13.0 -> 0.14.0). regen shows a diff and auth/retry integration tests are flaky.

jia: ack. can you paste the regen diff / failing test log?

matthew: here's the key part from the CI run: 
```
$ ./scripts/regenerate-sdks.sh --target sampleapp
> Regenerating types...
- func createUser(opts?: CreateUserOptions) -> old signature had optional opts param last
+ func createUser(opts?: CreateUserOptions) -> new signature stable but ordering changed for optional params
```
CI fails on import errors in sampleapp because codegen reordered optional params and the sampleapp pins old usage. also changelog check is failing: `changelog/CHANGELOG.md` wasn't bumped for typegen minor.

sam: ugh. semver bump from 0.13.0 -> 0.14.0 should have been a patch if it's just param reordering? why did the release pipeline pick minor?

olivia: looks like the typegen rule that detects "breaking API change" misfired. It treats optional param reorder as compatible but our SDK generator actually emits different overloads in TS, which breaks users.

matthew: also more concerning: the auth/retry tests started failing around the same time. sampleapp's login flow gets a `401` during CI then retry logic doesn't refresh token. logs show the SDK client used to call `auth.refresh()` on 401 but now it doesn't.

regendiff-bot: regendiff check queued (run #4521). Diff size: 27 lines.

jia: can you paste the failing test snippet?

matthew: 
```
FAIL tests/onboard.test.ts > "complete onboarding works"
  Error: Unauthorized
    at Client.request (/workspace/sdk/src/client.ts:122)
// client.ts shows change in retry config \n- if (shouldRetry(err) && retries < 3) { await backoff(retries); continue; }
+ if (shouldRetry(err) && config.retry === true) { await backoff(retries); continue; }
// but config.retry default flipped to false in 0.14.0
```

olivia: wait — why did default flip? that seems like a separate change in auth config file that landed in the same PR as the typegen bump. mixing concerns.

sam: probable cause: a release automation script picked up both a typegen bump and a runtime config tweak in the same commit. we should revert the default retry change asap if it breaks onboarding.

jia: agree. suggested next steps: 1) revert the retry default -> create hotfix release 0.14.1-patch; 2) fix typegen semver tagging or the typegen comparator so param reorder doesn't bump semver incorrectly; 3) add a CI guard that runs sampleapp imports against generated SDKs before releasing.

matthew: I'm spinning up a hotfix branch now, will open PR for revert: 
- PR: fix/sdks/retry-default-revert
- CI: will run regendiff + sampleapp import checks

regendiff-bot: regendiff run results: failures detected in sampleapp imports. Links: https://ci.internal/regendiff/4521

olivia: for the typegen issue, we probably need to change the comparator to consider TypeScript overload permutations. I can file an issue in repo: `typegen#402` with repro steps and diff.

sam: For the changelog mismatch, our release checklist should require updating CHANGELOG for any public semver bump. Add a presubmit that checks for changelog entry vs bumped package.json version.

matthew: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1789 — includes revert and adds an explicit default: `retry: true` in client constructor to preserve previous behavior. CI going now.

jia: will we also ship a patch for the typegen semver misclassification? If the comparator is too permissive, we could silently cause minor bumps and break downstream code.

olivia: filing the typegen issue now and will add a small test harness that runs a set of canonical sampleapps through the new generator and checks for import/runtime errors.

matthew: CI shows the revert fixed the auth test locally. pushing patch release after green. also adding a follow-up task to update release automation to not bundle unrelated changes.

sam: thanks. can someone add an item to the devex backlog: "regendiff gating: run sampleapp import tests + enforce changelog entry for semver bump"?

jia: done — ticket DEVEX-621.

matthew: thanks all. will update thread when patch release is published. :thumbsup:

olivia: minor note — sampleapp README should include `npx sdk@latest` guidance to catch API surface mismatches earlier; file a tiny doc PR?

sam: yes pls. small docs patch would reduce onboarding friction.

matthew: patch release published: 0.14.1 on npm and regen pipeline reverted. closing the loop.
